name: Kolamko (Koramco) Jangrim-dong massive data center
notes: Per Korean Financial News (Hankook Financial Times), Kolamko plans to break ground on a 'Massive' data center in Jangrim-dong, Saha-gu, Busan: ~46,900 sqm floor area, 40MW utility power (sucheon capacity). Part of Kolamko's ~KRW 5 trillion DC fund plan through 2028. Korean-language source; construction start planned as of Sep 2025.

name: (context) Busan Eco Delta City green data center cluster
developer: Busan Eco Delta Green Datacenter PFV / Empyrion DC / BEP & FutureSet / Ellis Group consortia
notes: Busan city signed a KRW 3.63 trillion investment MOU (Feb 2026) for a green data center cluster in Busan Eco Delta City; the Eco Delta district is administered by Gangseo-gu, though it abuts Saha-gu across the Nakdong River. Included here as related context only; exact Saha-gu parcel status unverified (grade C).

name: Sasang-gu data center cluster (Eomgung-dong)
notes: Sasang-gu and Boram Group agreed (Sep 2023) to swap land parcels in Eomgung-dong to build a 'data center cluster' as the anchor of a global IT industrial complex, expected ~KRW 9.77 trillion production effect. Local-government MOU/plan stage; no capacity or timeline published.

No datacenter projects found in Busan Seo-gu. Busan's main DC activity (Microsoft Busan DC 1&2 in Gangseo-gu, Noksan National Industrial Complex AI DC plans, Eco Delta cluster) is located in Gangseo-gu, outside this division.
No datacenter projects found in Busan Suyeong-gu after targeted searches (Korean and English).

No commercial datacenter projects found in Busan Yeongdo-gu. Only R&D concept coverage on seawater-cooled/underwater data centers by Korea Institute of Ocean Science & Technology (KIOST, located in Yeongdo-gu), not a build project.
No datacenter projects found in Busan Yeonje-gu.

name: D&R Partners Eumbong AI data center (Asan)
notes: Investment MOU signed 2026-03-30 with Chungcheongnam-do and Asan-si: 100MW AI data center on 119,339 sqm in Asan Eumbong-myeon (음봉), KRW 1.5 trillion invested by Mar 2029, ~300 new jobs.

name: Maltani Eumbong AI data center (Asan)
notes: Investment MOU signed 2026-03-30 with Chungcheongnam-do and Asan-si: 80MW AI data center on 38,520 sqm in Asan Eumbong-myeon, KRW 850 billion invested by Mar 2029, ~200 new jobs. Together with D&R Partners, two AI DCs concentrated in Asan Eumbong area.

name: Woongcheon E-Campus AI data center (Boryeong)
notes: MOU signed 2025-11-18 with Chungcheongnam-do and Boryeong-si (Hankyoreh report): KRW 2 trillion by 2029 to build a 100MW AI-specialized hyperscale data center on 103,109 sqm at Woongcheon Industrial Complex (웅천산업단지), Boryeong; ~150 local hires first; project financing via PPP-type structure.
No datacenter projects found in Buyeo-gun (Korean and English searches). Chungnam's AI DC investments are in Boryeong, Dangjin, Cheonan and Asan; Buyeo has no reported activity.

name: Geumgang Jiksan AI data center (Cheonan)
developer: Geumgang (금강, Chairman Kim Yong-seong); operator Fine&Partners Asset Management (파인앤파트너스자산운용)
notes: MOU signed 2026-01-29 with Chungcheongnam-do and Cheonan-si: 80MW AI data center on 102,642 sqm at Jiksan-eup Gunseori (직산읍 군서리), KRW 1.2 trillion by 2029; land secured and 80MW KEPCO power use agreement completed; ~200 jobs. Third Chungnam AI DC investment after Boryeong and Dangjin.

name: KT Cloud Cheonan Data Center (existing facility)
notes: Existing colocation/cloud data center in Cheonan operated by KT Cloud, listed in datacenters.com directory; KT engineering company history records 'KT Gimhae/Cheonan data center construction' around 2012. Capacity not published in cited sources.
